displayName: ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 4060 OC Edition 8GB GDDR6

identity.modelName: Dual GeForce RTX 4060 OC Edition 8GB GDDR6

dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: ASUS prints three unlabeled figures. 49.6 mm is identified as the thickness from the same page's published 2.5-slot width (2.5 x 20.32 mm = 50.8 mm); the remaining two are length and height by graphics-card convention, matching the derivation already used for gpu.asus-dual-rtx4070-o12g and gpu.asus-proart-rtx4080-o16g.

performanceSpec.boostClockBasis: Default Mode boost as published by ASUS; the page also lists OC Mode 2535 MHz, which requires ASUS software.

notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped. From source.cat6.asus.dual-rtx4060-o8g.techspec: slot width '2.5 Slot' (used above as the thickness basis), power connector '1 x 8-pin', recommended PSU '550W' (not modelled; compat2 sizes the PSU from CPU and GPU TDP with a stub headroom multiplier rather than a vendor recommendation). SKU: this is DUAL-RTX4060-O8G. ASUS separately sells a DUAL-RTX4060-O8G-V2 and a DUAL-RTX4060-O8G-WHITE; both are different products with their own pages and are not catalogued here. From source.cat6.nvidia.rtx4060-4060ti-family.reference-tgp: the RTX 4060 row states Total Graphics Power as a single unambiguous figure, 115 W. The adjacent RTX 4060 Ti row states '165 or 160' W without splitting the figure by 8GB/16GB memory configuration in the published table, which is why no RTX 4060 Ti SKU is catalogued from this source under C1 -- recording either number would assert a precision the source does not give.
